name: swat-hru-subset
description: Carve a SWAT+ dataset down to the HRUs you pick, in a new folder next to it, and run SWAT+ on the result.

commands.title: Create HRU Subset from This Folder…

viewsWelcome.contents:
Make a smaller copy of a SWAT+ dataset that keeps only the HRUs you pick.
[Create Subset…](command:swatHruSubset.createSubset)
You can also right-click a dataset folder in the Explorer, or run **SWAT+ HRU Subset: Create Subset…** from the Command Palette.

swatHruSubset.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter used to run the subset script. Empty: the environment variable `SWATPLUS_PYTHON`, then `py`, `python`, `python3` on Windows (`python3`, `python` elsewhere). The first one that answers `--version` is used; the Microsoft Store `python3` stub is skipped. The script runs with that one interpreter only.

swatHruSubset.swatExecutable.markdownDescription: SWAT+ executable that **Run SWAT+** starts in a terminal, with the new subset folder as the working directory. Empty: you are asked the first time and the choice is saved here.

scripts.compile: npm run copy-python && npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run copy-python && npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
